about: BHA-CI-FAST-001. The integration tests run in 4 CI jobs. Shards 1-3 run exactly the classes named here; shard 4 runs every class that is not named, so a new test class is never skipped (it lands in shard 4). Measured on the baseline (b8c73ff, local PostgreSQL 17, all passing): shards 1-3 about 317, 327, 316 s, shard 4 about 296 s. When shard 4 grows past the others, move a class from it into a named list. Only the balance depends on this file, never the coverage: the Backend gate compares what ran with the unfiltered list of tests.
